explanation: Allocate a height for every integer position from the minimum left endpoint to maximum right endpoint. Raise heights under each building, then compress adjacent equal heights into inclusive spans, including zero gaps.
timeComplexity: O(nU) worst case for n buildings and coordinate span U
spaceComplexity: O(U) dense heights, plus output spans
